description: Forced-angle current FOC at 0.500 A, the same speed and the same current vector magnitude as the six-step leg. Differs from it only in modulation.
notes: Matched-current leg of the three-scheme sweep.

Ripple UNDER-RESOLVED at 2.8 samples per ripple period — the figure is a lower bound. Both schemes are sampled identically at this speed, so the ratio between them remains valid even though the absolute values do not.
title: I-f FOC (sinusoidal), 898 rad/s el
